# Conversations

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/api_reference.py from contracts/openapi; do not edit. -->

Base path: `https://<gateway>/conversation`. Every call needs an API key or a Studio session (see [Authentication](index.md#authentication)). Request and response fields are in the OpenAPI document, `contracts/openapi/conversation.json`.

| Method | Path | What it does | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/conversations` | Newest first. |  | 200 list of `ConversationOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/conversations` | Create Conversation | `ConversationIn` | 201 `ConversationOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}` | Get Conversation |  | 200 `ConversationDetail` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}` | Delete your own conversation and everything in it. |  | 204 |
| `POST` | `/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/approval` | Approve or decline the action the assistant proposed. | `ApprovalIn` | 200 `TurnOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/handoff` | The user asks for a person. |  | 200 `TurnOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages` | Send a message; the reply carries the answer contract (citations, abstained, route...). | `MessageIn` | 200 `TurnOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages/stream` | Send a message and receive the reply as server-sent events. | `MessageIn` | 200, event stream |
| `POST` | `/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/queue` | Claim a handed-over conversation, give it back, resolve it, or reopen it. | `QueueAction` | 200 `ConversationOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/staff-messages` | A person from the team answers in a handed-over conversation. | `StaffMessageIn` | 201 `MessageOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/transcript` | Email the person a copy of their own conversation. | `TranscriptIn` | 202 `TranscriptOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/insights/gap-questions` | Questions the assistant could not answer, that were handed to a person, or whose answer was rated unhelpful. |  | 200 list of `GapQuestion` |
| `POST` | `/v1/messages/{message_id}/feedback` | Feedback | `FeedbackIn` | 204 |
